title: Microsoft Teams: Scoped Search for SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections)
description: With this feature, users accessing search through the Teams search icon while within the SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections) will be able to receive search result scoped to SharePoint global search. Hitting enter on the search query will then open the SharePoint search page.
